hero.guide.reworked_controls: At level 20 you have 20 skill points. Choose one passive, one major skill and one ultimate. You can learn both regular skills. Strength increases physical basic attacks and skills that scale with Strength. Wisdom increases magic basic attacks and skills, healing and shields that scale with spell power. Spend gold on attributes and supplies.
skill.myriad.g2_chixiao_ma.desc: Brace for 1 second and take 35% less non-true damage. If a qualifying hit lands during the brace, counter in a 5-block, 100° arc and stun for 0.6 seconds. True damage does not prime the counter.
skill.myriad.g2_chixiao_mb.desc: Launch a piercing blade wave up to 14 blocks at 31.2 blocks/s. Each enemy hit takes physical damage and is slowed by 30% for 2 seconds. Wind walls can block it.
skill.myriad.g2_chixiao_n1.desc: Cleave in a 100° arc reaching 6 blocks ahead. Solid walls block the strike.
skill.myriad.g2_chixiao_n2.desc: Dash 7 blocks horizontally and hit enemies along the path, slowing them by 30% for 1.5 seconds. Recast within 3 seconds to dash back along a clear line. Returning uses no mana, does not reset the cooldown and deals no further damage.
skill.myriad.g2_chixiao_pa.desc: Direct hits to the same enemy hero build Battle Intent, once per cast. At three stacks, your next direct skill hit adds true damage and consumes the stacks. Changing targets or going 6 seconds without a hit clears them.
skill.myriad.g2_chixiao_pb.desc: At or below 40% health, your next direct hit grants a 3-second shield ({support0}) and 15% movement speed for 2 seconds. Available once every 12 seconds.
skill.myriad.g2_chixiao_ua.desc: Leap to an unobstructed standing point within 12 blocks. Only a successful landing hits enemies within 4.5 blocks and slows by 40% for 2 seconds.
skill.myriad.g2_chixiao_ub.desc: Gain a 6-second shield ({support0}). While the 6-second window lasts, your first three successful basic attacks each add one separate physical hit.
skill.myriad.g2_hanze_ma.desc: Choose a point within 14 blocks and channel in place for 1 second. A 4.5-block-radius burst deals magic damage and roots for 1.2 seconds. Control can interrupt it.
skill.myriad.g2_hanze_mb.desc: Fire a piercing ice lance up to 18 blocks at 31.2 blocks/s. Each enemy hit takes magic damage and is slowed by 40% for 2 seconds. Wind walls can block it.
skill.myriad.g2_hanze_n1.desc: Fire three ice shards 0.25 seconds apart. Each follows your aim at its launch and travels up to 15 blocks at 39 blocks/s. The first enemy hit takes magic damage and is slowed by 20% for 1 second. Wind walls can block the shards.
skill.myriad.g2_hanze_n2.desc: Gain a 4-second shield ({support0}) and immediately slow enemies within 3 blocks by 25% for 1.5 seconds. Reapplying the same shield keeps the higher amount.
skill.myriad.g2_hanze_pa.desc: Direct basics and skills apply Frost to an enemy, once per cast. Four stacks deal magic damage and root for 1 second. Stacks expire after 6 seconds. The target cannot gain new stacks for 6 seconds after the root.
skill.myriad.g2_hanze_pb.desc: A direct hit grants a 3-second shield ({support0}) and slows enemies within 3 blocks by 20% for 1 second. Available once every 12 seconds.
skill.myriad.g2_hanze_ua.desc: Place a 7-block-radius ice field within 14 blocks. Every second for 6 seconds, enemies inside take magic damage and are slowed by 35% for 1 second.
skill.myriad.g2_hanze_ub.desc: Give yourself and visible allies within 6 blocks a 5-second shield ({support0}). Simultaneously hit enemies within 5 blocks for magic damage and root them for 1 second.
skill.myriad.g2_lingyuan_ma.desc: Fire three swords 0.2 seconds apart. Each uses your aim at its launch, travels up to 18 blocks at 39 blocks/s and deals magic damage to the first enemy hit. Terrain and wind walls stop the swords.
skill.myriad.g2_lingyuan_mb.desc: Place a 4-block-radius sword field within 14 blocks. Every second for 4 seconds, enemies inside take magic damage and are slowed by 25% for 1 second.
skill.myriad.g2_lingyuan_n1.desc: Dash 6 blocks horizontally, hitting each enemy along the path once for physical damage. Terrain stops the dash.
skill.myriad.g2_lingyuan_n2.desc: Gain a 4-second shield ({support0}). For the first 2 seconds, take 15% less non-true damage.
skill.myriad.g2_lingyuan_pa.desc: A basic attack earns 10 sword energy. Each 100 energy creates a sword, up to four. Every 2 seconds, your swords attack the last visible enemy you hit within 10 blocks. Those attacks cannot trigger this passive.
skill.myriad.g2_lingyuan_pb.desc: After three successful active casts, your next basic attack adds a separate magic hit and gives you a 3-second shield ({support0}). The basic hit keeps its usual damage.
skill.myriad.g2_lingyuan_ua.desc: Place a 10-block-radius sword field within 14 blocks. It deals magic damage once per second for 6 seconds. Enemies can leave the area between pulses.
skill.myriad.g2_lingyuan_ub.desc: Charge in place for 1.2 seconds and swing a giant sword over 0.3 seconds. Strike enemies once in a 15-block-long, 3-block-wide area aligned with your initial aim. Solid walls block the strike. Control or displacement can interrupt it.
skill.myriad.g2_qingluo_ma.desc: Place a 4-block-radius field within 14 blocks. At opening and once per second for 4 seconds, allies inside gain a 1.25-second shield ({support0}). Reapplication keeps the higher amount from the same caster.
skill.myriad.g2_qingluo_mb.desc: Shield a targeted ally within 12 blocks, or yourself, for 4 seconds ({support0}). While linked, heal once per second up to four times ({support1}). Moving beyond 14 blocks, obstruction or death breaks the link.
skill.myriad.g2_qingluo_n1.desc: Heal a visible ally under your aim within 12 blocks ({support0}) and grant 15% movement speed for 1.5 seconds. Target yourself if no ally is selected.
skill.myriad.g2_qingluo_n2.desc: Fire a seed up to 15 blocks at 31.2 blocks/s. The first enemy hit takes magic damage and is rooted for 0.7 seconds. Allies within 3 blocks of the impact are healed ({support0}). Wind walls can stop the seed.
skill.myriad.g2_qingluo_pa.desc: When your skill heals or adds a shield to an ally below 60% health, heal them again ({support0}) and give them 10% movement speed for 2 seconds. Available once per ally every 4 seconds.
skill.myriad.g2_qingluo_pb.desc: A direct hit grants one dose of Dew, up to three and at most one per cast. Your next effective heal or shield spends all doses and heals for {support0} per dose.
skill.myriad.g2_qingluo_ua.desc: Place a 7-block-radius grove within 14 blocks. Every second for 6 seconds, visible allies inside are healed ({support0}).
skill.myriad.g2_qingluo_ub.desc: Heal yourself and visible allies within 8 blocks ({support0}). Grant a 5-second shield ({support1}) and 20% movement speed for 3 seconds.
skill.myriad.g2_yunsheng_ma.desc: Place a 4-block-radius beacon within 14 blocks for 8 seconds. It refreshes a 1.25-second allied shield each second ({support0}). An enemy entering the field first takes one magic hit and a 30% slow for 1 second.
skill.myriad.g2_yunsheng_mb.desc: Dash to a standing point within 8 blocks. At your actual stopping point, visible allies within 3 blocks gain a 3-second shield ({support0}) and 20% movement speed for 1.5 seconds. Terrain can stop the dash.
skill.myriad.g2_yunsheng_n1.desc: Send a paper crane to a visible target within 14 blocks, favoring an enemy under your aim, then an ally, then yourself. It damages and slows enemies by 25% for 1 second, or heals an ally ({support0}) and restores 20 mana. Terrain and wind walls can block it.
skill.myriad.g2_yunsheng_n2.desc: Bind a visible enemy within 12 blocks for a magic hit and a 0.6-second root. If the line stays clear and in range for 2 seconds, hit again and slow by 30% for 1.5 seconds. A broken link stays broken.
skill.myriad.g2_yunsheng_pa.desc: After you effectively heal or shield the same ally twice within 6 seconds, grant that ally a 3-second shield ({support0}). Available once per ally every 8 seconds.
skill.myriad.g2_yunsheng_pb.desc: A direct hit on an enemy hero heals yourself and visible allies within 6 blocks ({support0}) and grants 10% movement speed for 1 second. Available once every 6 seconds.
skill.myriad.g2_yunsheng_ua.desc: Channel in place for 1 second, then open a 6-block-radius field within 14 blocks. Once per second for 4 seconds, it heals allies ({support0}) and deals magic damage to enemies. Control can interrupt the channel.
skill.myriad.g2_yunsheng_ub.desc: Give yourself and visible allies within 8 blocks a 5-second shield ({support0}) and 25% movement speed for 3 seconds.
skill.myriad.keheng_chijie.desc: Choose supported, visible ground within 10 blocks. After a 0.45-second warning, a 3.5-block field opens and deals one hit. The field lasts 3 seconds plus 0.25 seconds per rank after the first and slows enemy action and projectile speed to 65%–50%. Walls and floors block effects across the boundary.
skill.myriad.keheng_chizhen.desc: After a 0.2-second windup, fire a needle 12 blocks at 31.2 blocks per second. It stops at the first enemy. A hit slows the target's action rate to 85%–65% for 1.25 seconds, reduced by tenacity. Projectiles already in flight keep their speed.
skill.myriad.keheng_cuopaibu.desc: Dash 4.5 blocks in the movement direction in about 0.25 seconds. Walls stop the dash. Leave a 2-block field for 1.5 seconds at 80% action and projectile speed. Gain a shield of 35 + 10 per rank after the first + 15% spell power for 2 seconds.
skill.myriad.keheng_hengbu.desc: Entering your own time field grants a 75 + 15 per rank after the first + 30% spell power shield for 2 seconds. The 12-second internal cooldown runs in real time. This shield is independent of Offbeat Step.
skill.myriad.keheng_kehen.desc: Three distinct active casts hit a hero within a fixed 4-second window to trigger bonus magic damage. Each cast counts once. Hits absorbed by shields count. Invulnerability prevents a stack.
skill.myriad.keheng_suixing.desc: After a 0.25-second windup, carry a 3-block field for 2.5 seconds plus 0.15 seconds per rank after the first. The field slows actions and projectiles to 75%–60%. Natural expiry damages enemies still inside. Recast or hard control cancels the field without a hit. Roots leave it active.
skill.myriad.keheng_yimiao.desc: Choose ground within 12 blocks. After a 0.65-second independent warning, a 4-block dome slows actions and projectiles to 40%–30% for 3 seconds. It pulses six times, once per half-second of real time.
skill.myriad.keheng_zhongke.desc: Stand still for 0.8 seconds to open a 12×3×3 corridor facing the original cast direction. Walls stop the corridor. During the windup, enemy action rate is 70% and projectile rate is 40%. The finishing strike hits each enemy still inside once. Hard control interrupts it.
skill.myriad.shuo_cangfeng.desc: Build 40 edge per second while sheathed, up to 100. Your next draw adds physical damage in proportion to stored edge. Full edge grants full damage and half edge grants half. Drawing consumes the edge even on a miss. The extra basic attack damage cannot critically strike.
skill.myriad.shuo_canyue.desc: Sheathed: unleash three cuts with a 0.2-second windup each. Recast within 2 seconds. Tap for a standing cut, or hold the skill for 0.15 seconds to advance up to 4 blocks. Stop about one block short of the first enemy ahead, then cut. The first cut slows by 25% for 1 second. The final cut roots for 0.5 seconds if all three hit. Only the opening cast costs mana. Drawn: charge for 0.3 seconds, deliver one wide finishing slash and sheathe.
skill.myriad.shuo_duanliu.desc: Sheathed: charge for 0.45 seconds and cut a 7-block lane. The first cut deals 60%, adds any draw bonus and slows by 35% for 1 second. After 0.3 seconds, cut the same lane for the remaining 40%. Hitting twice roots for 0.4 seconds. Drawn: strike immediately and again after 0.2 seconds. You can turn between cuts. Hitting twice roots for 0.3 seconds. Control interrupts follow-up cuts.
skill.myriad.shuo_jianqie.desc: After a successful guard with Guard Counter, your next draw within 4 seconds adds physical damage. Drawing spends the bonus. The counter requires a separate input.
skill.myriad.shuo_nadao.desc: Sheathed: step back diagonally 3 blocks and gain 20% movement speed for 1.5 seconds. Drawn: slash a 3-block arc and step back diagonally. The first slash deals 60% of the damage. After 0.35 seconds, a return slash at the starting point deals the remaining 40% and slows by 30% for 1 second. Control can interrupt the return slash. After the retreat, sheathe for 0.4 seconds. Wall collisions stop the step.
skill.myriad.shuo_qiaofan.desc: Sheathed: guard against one frontal non-true hit for 0.35 seconds. Towers and environmental damage bypass the guard. On a successful guard, cast again within 2 seconds to draw and counter without paying mana again. An effective counter stuns for 0.3 seconds and grants a shield for 2 seconds. Drawn: sweep a 3.5-block arc and slow by 30% for 1 second.
skill.myriad.shuo_wusheng.desc: Sheathed: charge for 0.7 seconds, dash 12 blocks and mark enemies in your path. After sheathing for 0.4 seconds, hit marked enemies once and include any draw bonus. The hit deals up to 25% more damage based on missing target health. Drawn: dash 6 blocks, then slash a 5-block arc and stun for 0.6 seconds. Walls stop the dash and control can interrupt the finishing slash.
skill.myriad.shuo_yishan.desc: Sheathed: charge for 0.5 seconds and dash 7 blocks. Deal 60% on contact and mark targets. The wound deals the remaining 40% 0.3 seconds after the dash and slows by 35% for 1 second. Apply a stored draw bonus only on the first hit. Drawn: dash 4 blocks and hit each enemy once, slowing by 25% for 1 second. Walls halt both dashes.

skill.myriad.g1_yingxiao_pa.desc: Direct basic attacks and skills from behind deal 10% more damage at rank 1, plus 5 percentage points per additional rank, up to 30%. Applies within the rear 120° and excludes periodic, secondary and true damage.
skill.myriad.g1_yingxiao_pb.desc: Deal bonus physical damage to an enemy hero on a direct hit if no other enemy hero is within 4 blocks of them. Each target can trigger this once every 8 seconds.
skill.myriad.g1_yingxiao_n1.desc: Throw a dagger up to 15 blocks at 39 blocks/s. It hits the first enemy for physical damage and slows by 25% for 1.5 seconds. Terrain and wind walls can stop it.
skill.myriad.g1_yingxiao_n2.desc: Become invisible for 2 seconds, plus 0.25 seconds per additional rank, and gain 15% movement speed. An attack or another successful skill cast ends invisibility. Detection still works.
skill.myriad.g1_yingxiao_ma.desc: Dash 9 blocks horizontally in about 0.25 seconds. Deal physical damage once per enemy in the path and stop at solid walls. A rear hit on the first enemy slows them by 40% for 1 second.
skill.myriad.g1_yingxiao_mb.desc: Dash to a ground point within 7 blocks and hit enemies along the way once. Recast within 3 seconds to blink back to the starting shadow. Returning deals no damage and requires freedom to move.
skill.myriad.g1_yingxiao_ua.desc: Target a visible enemy hero within 8 blocks. After a stationary 0.8-second windup, blink to a safe spot behind them and stab once. Control, blocked sight, invalid targets or a blocked landing cancel the strike.
skill.myriad.g1_yingxiao_ub.desc: Cleanse current movement and action impairments even while controlled. Gain a 4-second shield ({support0}) and 20% movement speed for 2 seconds. New controls can still affect you.
skill.myriad.g1_tianxing_pa.desc: Every third successful basic attack against the same target adds true damage and splashes magic damage to up to two other enemies within 3 blocks. Switching targets or going 4 seconds without a hit resets the count.
skill.myriad.g1_tianxing_pb.desc: A direct skill hit on a hero primes your next basic attack within 4 seconds. It adds magic damage and splashes half that amount to up to two other enemies within 3 blocks. This can be primed once every 6 seconds.
skill.myriad.g1_tianxing_n1.desc: Blink to a visible, supported landing point up to 6 blocks away horizontally, 2.5 blocks up or 4 blocks down. Deal physical damage once to enemies within 2.5 blocks of the landing point.
skill.myriad.g1_tianxing_n2.desc: After a stationary 0.3-second charge, throw an arc up to 18 blocks at 65 blocks/s. It stops on the first enemy, slowing that target by 25% for 1.5 seconds. Other enemies within 4 blocks and in clear sight of the impact take 35% chain damage once. Terrain and wind walls stop the arc.
skill.myriad.g1_tianxing_ma.desc: For 4 seconds, take 15% less non-true damage and deal magic damage to enemies within 4 blocks once per second. Protection from multiple rings does not stack.
skill.myriad.g1_tianxing_mb.desc: Charge in place for 0.5 seconds, then fire a piercing sword wave up to 20 blocks at 104 blocks/s. Each target takes magic damage once. Root the first enemy hero for 0.6 seconds. Terrain and wind walls block the wave, and control can interrupt the charge.
skill.myriad.g1_tianxing_ua.desc: Mark a 5-block-radius area within 12 blocks. After a 0.4-second warning, six lightning strikes land half a second apart. The final strike roots enemies for 0.8 seconds.
skill.myriad.g1_tianxing_ub.desc: Charge in place for 0.6 seconds, then strike enemies in the current facing direction within an 8-block, 120° arc. Each visible enemy takes physical damage and is stunned for 0.8 seconds. Control can interrupt the charge.
skill.myriad.g1_fenjue_pa.desc: Direct skill hits apply a 3-second burn that deals true damage once per second. Further hits refresh its duration without stacking. The burn cannot crit or trigger itself.
skill.myriad.g1_fenjue_pb.desc: At or below 20% health, your next direct non-true skill damage is increased by 10%, plus 4 percentage points per additional rank. Only one cast is boosted per 8 seconds, including its eligible strikes.
skill.myriad.g1_fenjue_n1.desc: Sweep two crossing flame cuts up to about 7 blocks. The cuts land 0.2 seconds apart and each deals physical damage. Their aim is fixed at cast and walls block hits. Ember Heart can apply its separate burn.
skill.myriad.g1_fenjue_n2.desc: Dash 8 blocks along your horizontal facing, leaving a flame trail. Hit each enemy along the path once for physical damage. Solid walls stop movement.
skill.myriad.g1_fenjue_ma.desc: Mark a ground point within 12 blocks. After a 0.6-second warning, create a 3.5-block-radius cage for 4 seconds. Enemies inside are slowed by 25% and take physical damage once per second. They can walk out.
skill.myriad.g1_fenjue_mb.desc: Channel for 0.65 seconds, then strike enemies within 6 blocks. Every 10% missing health adds 2% damage, up to 16%. You may turn and walk at 25% speed while charging. Stun or silence interrupts it.
skill.myriad.g1_fenjue_ua.desc: Choose a clear landing within 14 blocks and leap at least 5 blocks above takeoff. Landing hits enemies within 5 blocks and leaves fire that deals physical damage every second for 4 seconds. A blocked or interrupted leap does not hit.
skill.myriad.g1_fenjue_ub.desc: Gain a 5-second shield ({support0}). While the shield holds, enemies within 3 blocks take physical damage once per second, up to four times. The damage stops if the shield breaks.
skill.myriad.g1_xuanchen_pa.desc: After a successful active skill, shield the lowest-health ally within 8 blocks for 2 seconds ({support0}). Shields yourself if no eligible ally is nearby. The effect can trigger once every 12 seconds.
skill.myriad.g1_xuanchen_pb.desc: A direct skill hit marks an enemy hero for 4 seconds. A different active skill can consume the mark for bonus magic damage. The same cast and damage over time cannot trigger it. The target then has an 8-second cooldown.
skill.myriad.g1_xuanchen_n1.desc: Launch a chain up to 16 blocks at 32.5 blocks/s. The first enemy takes magic damage and is rooted for 0.6 seconds, plus 0.1 seconds per additional rank. Wind walls can block it.
skill.myriad.g1_xuanchen_n2.desc: Give a targeted visible ally within 10 blocks, or yourself, a 3-second shield ({support0}). Reapplying before it breaks keeps the higher amount.
skill.myriad.g1_xuanchen_ma.desc: Create two linked standing points at your feet and at a chosen spot within 14＋r blocks. They last 4 seconds, plus 0.3 seconds per additional rank. Allies interact to teleport with a 2-second reuse cooldown. Only one pair can exist.
skill.myriad.g1_xuanchen_mb.desc: Mark an area within 12 blocks. After 0.6 seconds, a 4-block-radius field lasts 4 seconds, reducing allied non-true damage taken by 12% and slowing enemies by 25%. Allies in the field when it opens gain a 2-second shield ({support0}).
skill.myriad.g1_xuanchen_ua.desc: Channel in place for 0.8 seconds, then open a 6-block-radius field for 4 seconds. Allies take 15% less non-true damage and enemies are slowed by 30% and take magic damage once per second. Control can interrupt the channel.
skill.myriad.g1_xuanchen_ub.desc: Mark a 4-block-radius area within 12 blocks. After a 0.7-second warning, deal magic damage and root enemies for 1 second. The remaining seal slows by 20% for 3 seconds.
skill.myriad.g1_sulan_pa.desc: Walking 30 horizontal blocks primes one bonus hit. The next basic attack that hits an enemy deals bonus physical damage. Dashes, teleports and knockback do not count toward the distance.
skill.myriad.g1_sulan_pb.desc: Directly hitting an enemy hero with a skill primes your next basic attack within 3 seconds. It deals bonus physical damage and slows by 15% for 1 second.
skill.myriad.g1_sulan_n1.desc: Dash 6 blocks toward your aim and deal physical damage once per enemy along the path. Terrain blocks the dash and roots prevent it.
skill.myriad.g1_sulan_n2.desc: Hit a visible enemy within 14 blocks, slow them by 20% for 1.5 seconds and mark them for 4 seconds. Your next direct non-true hit consumes the mark and deals an extra 6% damage, plus 1 percentage point per additional rank.
skill.myriad.g1_sulan_ma.desc: Raise a wind wall 2 blocks ahead that is 6 blocks long and 4 blocks high. It lasts 2.5 seconds, plus 0.2 seconds per additional rank. It intercepts eligible enemy projectiles.
skill.myriad.g1_sulan_mb.desc: Throw a wind blade up to 12 blocks at 26 blocks/s. It then returns toward your current position. Each enemy can take physical damage once in each direction. Wind walls can stop it.
skill.myriad.g1_sulan_ua.desc: Charge in place for 0.5 seconds, then dash up to 12 blocks with limited steering. Stopping or meeting the first enemy hero hits enemies within 2.5 blocks and slows by 30% for 1.5 seconds. Terrain blocks the dash and control interrupts charging.
skill.myriad.g1_sulan_ub.desc: Open a 5-block-radius field for 4 seconds. The opening deals one physical hit. In the field allies gain 15% movement speed and enemies are slowed by 25%.

guide.myriad.title: MYRIAD Handbook
guide.myriad.page1:
Objective

Guardian (blue) faces Destruction (red). 5v5 has three lanes; 3v3 has one.

Push with minions. Destroy all enemy towers in one lane to unlock the crystal.
guide.myriad.page2:
Draft

Both sides share the roster. Follow the draft order; heroes are unique. Right-click a portrait for a guide.

After drafting, teams prepare at their fountains.
guide.myriad.page3:
Levels and Skills

Earn XP from minions, monsters and heroes. Max level: 20. Start with 1 skill point and gain 1 per level.

Press C. Choose one passive, one main and one ultimate branch. Both regular skills can be learned.
guide.myriad.page4:
Lanes and Jungle

Minions first spawn at 1:10, then every 40 seconds. Bring a wave to avoid backdoor protection.

Monsters grant gold and XP. Know where your allies are before invading.
guide.myriad.page5:
Gold and Attributes

Press C and double-click an attribute to buy a point. Each attribute starts at 360 gold. The next point in that attribute costs 120% of its current price, rounded to the nearest gold.

Strength increases physical basic attacks and skills that scale with Strength. Wisdom increases magic basic attacks and skills, healing and shields that scale with spell power. Speed improves attack and movement speed, Defense improves resistances, and Haste reduces cooldowns by up to 60%.
guide.myriad.page6:
Tactical Supplies

You start with 500 gold. Open Supplies from C. Shop within 10 blocks of your base or while waiting to respawn.

Potions restore health or mana. Traps guard routes; totems and true-sight charms help with vision.
guide.myriad.page7:
Vision and Signals

Right-click with a scout totem to place it within 6 blocks. Check vision before entering brush.

Hold middle mouse to pick a team signal. Release to mark a spot within 18 blocks.
guide.myriad.page8:
Recall and Respawn

B channels recall by default. Movement or combat interrupts it.

While dead, you can watch living allies. Press J or use /myriad recap for your death recap.
guide.myriad.page9:
Catch-up Rewards

Gold catch-up compares average gold earned this match by each side's online participants. Spending does not lower that total.

XP catch-up uses your level gap from the enemy team.
guide.myriad.page10:
Team Objectives

Push the wave before grouping for a camp or tower. Signal for help before entering dangerous brush.

Finish by destroying the enemy crystal.

hero.guide.hanze: 冰霜控场前排。叠霜定身或周期护盾二选一；用冰锥远程消耗、霜盾承伤，主要和终极可选择控区或团队保护。没有旧版最大生命真实伤害。
hero.guide.lingyuan: 御剑压制战士。普攻养剑或施法蓄势二选一；两种终极分别是大范围持续剑雨、蓄力贯穿巨剑。注意飞剑不会无限提速或穿透，法力仍限制施法。
hero.guide.qingluo: 治疗与保护辅助。仁心擅长救低血队友，药露擅长先攻击后治疗。丹阵保护一块区域，渡厄保护单个队友；终极可选持续恢复或即时群体护盾。
hero.guide.chixiao: 突进与反打的重刃战士。断岳斩是前方扇形攻击，追魂踏有一次返回；主要选招架反打或刀罡消耗。战意附加伤害与强化普攻均由智慧增强，不提供旧全能吸血。
hero.guide.yunsheng: 灵契支援辅助。弧线纸鹤能攻击敌人或治疗友军，定契索隔墙/超距即断；用界标守区或护行支援，终极可选引导回响域或即时护盾加速。

hero.guide.shuo: A melee draw-cut specialist. Build edge while sheathed, find an opening, draw and resheathe. Left-click remains a vanilla single-target melee attack. Right-click while drawn to resheathe (0.4s attack lock). Flash/Three Crescents favor initiation; Perfect Read/Sheath Reversal reward timing. Dashes do not pass through walls.

skill.myriad.keheng_suixing.description: 0.25s windup, moving 3 block field for 2.5+0.15(r-1)s at rate 0.75 to 0.60. Natural expiry deals 90+18(r-1)+0.50S magic to enemies still inside. Press E or hard control to cancel without damage. Roots do not interrupt.
skill.myriad.keheng_yimiao.name: Beyond One Second
skill.myriad.keheng_yimiao.description: Choose ground within 12 blocks. After a 0.65s warning, a dome with a 5 block radius lasts 3s. Enemy action rate 0.35/0.30/0.25 and projectile rate 0.40/0.35/0.30. Six pulses, one per 0.5s, each dealing 24+9.2(r-1)+0.12S magic damage.
skill.myriad.keheng_zhongke.name: Final Penetration
skill.myriad.keheng_zhongke.description: Root yourself for 0.80s, locking a 14×3.6×3 corridor in the cast direction, stopped by walls. During windup enemy action rate is 0.60 and projectile rate is 0.40. Finish for 330+125(r-1)+1.35S magic damage once per enemy. Hard control interrupts the cast.
skill.myriad.yike_rainbow_mark.desc: Hit the same hero with three distinct paid active casts to trigger bonus magic damage. Each cast contributes one stack. Stacks expire 6 seconds after the latest hit.
skill.myriad.yike_steady_barrier.desc: Move no more than 0.3 blocks horizontally over 1.2 seconds to prime a shield. Your next committed active skill grants the shield for 2.5 seconds. The shield is 65 + 15 per rank after the first + 25% spell power. The 12-second internal cooldown runs in real time.
skill.myriad.yike_rainbow_shell.desc: Wind up for 0.25 seconds at 50% movement speed. Pay mana for the current skill rank and start recovery when the shell fires. In the standard stance it travels up to 16 blocks at 39 blocks per second and has a 1.5-block blast radius. Artillery stances modify its range, timing and damage.
skill.myriad.yike_refraction_denial.desc: Place a 2.5-block warning on allowed ground within 14 blocks. After 0.55 seconds it bursts and slows enemies by 30% for 1.25 seconds. An unlaunched shell is canceled. Move at 50% speed during initial recovery and wait 0.55 seconds before firing again.
skill.myriad.yike_fixed_artillery.desc: Deploy after 0.45 seconds and hold position for up to 6 seconds. Fire up to five shells manually with Q. Each pays the current Q rank's mana cost, reaches 26 blocks at 44.2 blocks per second and deals 65%–80% of the current Q damage. Shots are at least 1.1 seconds apart.
skill.myriad.yike_mobile_array.desc: Deploy after 0.35 seconds. Move at 70% speed without sprinting for up to 6 seconds. Fire up to four shells manually with Q. Each pays the current Q rank's mana cost, reaches 20 blocks at 39 blocks per second and blasts a 1-block radius for 55%–70% of current Q damage. Shots are at least 1.35 seconds apart.
skill.myriad.yike_distant_bombardment.de: Choose visible ground within 26 blocks. Pay on confirmation and stand still through the 0.6-second windup. The shell travels in an arc for at least 0.4 seconds, then explodes in a 4-block radius and hits each target once. Walls stop it.
skill.myriad.yike_prismatic_beam.desc: Pay at the start of a 0.6-second stationary windup. Project a 22-block beam that hits six times over 3 seconds. Aim can turn at up to 45 degrees per second. Walls stop the beam. Recast to cancel it.
character.myriad.luoxia.desc: A ranged archer. Hold the attack key to draw, then release to fire. Choose rapid follow-up shots or precise long-range fire.
skill.myriad.luoxia_chase_dusk.desc: A basic attack hitting an enemy hero lets you draw your next basic arrow faster within 1.2 seconds. The quick arrow deals 90% damage. Hitting another hero refreshes the window.
skill.myriad.luoxia_steady_dusk.desc: Reach full draw in 1 second at base attack speed. Higher attack speed shortens the draw. A full-draw arrow reaches 26 blocks and deals 121%–145% basic attack damage. Move 20% slower while at full draw.
skill.myriad.luoxia_dusk_mark.desc: Shoot a straight arrow up to 20 blocks. Hitting an enemy hero marks them for 3 seconds. Your next basic or skill arrow that hits that hero consumes the mark for extra physical damage.
skill.myriad.luoxia_slant_step.desc: Slide 3 blocks in the movement direction, or backward with no movement input. Walls stop the slide. The dodge preserves bow draw progress.
skill.myriad.luoxia_feather_burst.desc: Fire three light arrows over 0.5 seconds, each reaching up to 19 blocks. Each arrow follows your aim when fired. The third hit on the same target deals half damage.
skill.myriad.luoxia_last_sun.desc: Draw for 0.5 seconds while moving slowly, then fire a heavy arrow up to 28 blocks. It stops at the first enemy.
skill.myriad.luoxia_thousand_feathers.de: After a brief windup, fire three narrow volleys up to 22 blocks. Each enemy can take one hit per volley.
skill.myriad.luoxia_sunset_line.desc: Stand still and draw for 0.85 seconds. The final warning locks the direction. The arrow travels up to 32 blocks, piercing minor units and up to three heroes. Each successive hero takes less damage. Walls stop the arrow.
character.myriad.rivet.desc: Armored frontliner who uses wall anchors, an impact hammer and a tow cable to control positioning.
skill.myriad.rivet_station_armor.desc: Stand on the ground within 4 blocks of your anchor for 2 seconds to gain a shield of 68 + 18 per rank after the first + 40% spell power. Leaving for 2 seconds removes the shield. Return and ground for 2 seconds to recover 20% of its current full value. A broken shield takes at least 10 seconds to recover.
skill.myriad.rivet_breach_rhythm.desc: A wall collision from Impact Hammer empowers your next basic attack for 4 seconds, once every 5 seconds. The extra hit cannot critically strike. An effective hit reduces your main ability's remaining cooldown by 2 seconds.
skill.myriad.rivet_impact_hammer.desc: Wind up and hit enemies within 3 blocks ahead. The first target near the crosshair is pushed 2 blocks. A wall collision within 0.4 seconds deals extra damage and roots for 0.5 seconds. A collision near your anchor roots for 0.8 seconds.
skill.myriad.rivet_tactical_anchor.desc: Place an anchor on a solid wall face within 8 blocks for 18 seconds. Recasting replaces it. Wall collisions within 1.5 blocks can trigger an anchor strike once every 5 seconds. Replacing the anchor preserves this recovery. Rank zero is available. Preparation placement is free and anchor strikes activate at the start of combat.
skill.myriad.rivet_emergency_strut.desc: Shield yourself and allies within 3 blocks for 2 seconds. The shield is 95 + 22 per rank after the first + 50% spell power. Reduce your own knockback by 50% while the effect lasts. Casting within 4 blocks of your anchor reduces the anchor's remaining cooldown by 2 seconds. Overlapping strut shields retain the stronger remainder.
skill.myriad.rivet_tow_cable.desc: Pull yourself to a safe point in front of your visible anchor within 15 blocks. An obstruction or invalid anchor stops the pull. Recast during movement to release the line.
skill.myriad.rivet_hold_protocol.desc: Lock in a 4-block zone around an anchor within 10 blocks for 6 seconds. You and allies inside take 15% less damage. On your first entry, gain a shield of 142 + 50 per rank after the first + 60% spell power until the zone ends. Impact Hammer pushes enemies inside 25% farther. The zone persists if you replace or lose the anchor.
skill.myriad.rivet_breach_charge.desc: Charge up for 0.7 seconds, then surge up to 10 blocks. The first effective hit carries the enemy forward until the charge stops. On a wall collision, deal one extra hit and root for 0.8 seconds. An anchor strike roots for 1 second. Obstacles and interruptions stop the push.

skill.myriad.rivet_emergency_strut.hover: Shield yourself and nearby allies and reduce the knockback you take.

skill.myriad.rivet_tow_cable.hover.limit: Your anchor must be visible and the path to it must fit your body.

skill.myriad.rivet_hold_protocol.hover.l: Cast near an active anchor. Replacing it leaves the zone in place.

skill.myriad.yike_steady_barrier.hover.l: Side-to-side steps count toward the movement limit.
skill.myriad.yike_rainbow_shell.hover.su: Fire a shell that explodes on contact with an enemy or terrain, or at the end of its range.
skill.myriad.yike_rainbow_shell.hover.li: Learn this skill before firing. Mana is spent on firing. Artillery stances have their own range and shot interval.
skill.myriad.yike_refraction_denial.hove: Mark the ground for a delayed blast that damages and slows enemies.
Cancels a shell still winding up and briefly delays the next artillery shot.

Firing requires the learned shell skill and costs mana per shot. Recast the stance to exit.

skill.myriad.yike_mobile_array.hover.lim: Sprinting is disabled. Firing requires the learned shell skill. Recast the stance to exit.
skill.myriad.yike_distant_bombardment.ho: Target the ground, wind up, then lob a shell that blasts enemies around the landing point.
Confirming the target spends mana. Terrain and enemy wind walls destroy the shell in flight.
skill.myriad.yike_prismatic_beam.hover.s: Wind up in place, then channel a beam. Turn slowly to sweep it across enemies.
skill.myriad.yike_prismatic_beam.hover.l: Walls block the beam. Recast to end it early.
skill.myriad.yike_prismatic_beam.hover.s: Up to %s s of fire · %s pulses
skill.myriad.shuo_cangfeng.hover.summary: Build edge while sheathed to add damage to your next draw.
skill.myriad.shuo_cangfeng.hover.limit: Drawing spends all edge, even on a miss.
skill.myriad.shuo_jianqie.hover.summary: Parry with Sheath Reversal to empower your next draw.
skill.myriad.shuo_jianqie.hover.limit: Draw to use the bonus. A miss still spends it.
skill.myriad.shuo_nadao.hover.summary: Sheathed, step back and gain speed. Drawn, slash and retreat, then slow enemies at the starting point.
skill.myriad.shuo_nadao.hover.limit: Casting with your blade drawn sheathes it. Control can cancel the return slash.
skill.myriad.shuo_qiaofan.hover.summary: Sheathed, parry a frontal hit and recast to counter. Drawn, sweep to slow enemies.
skill.myriad.shuo_qiaofan.hover.limit: Land the counter to stun and gain a shield. Tower hits and true damage bypass the parry.
skill.myriad.shuo_yishan.hover.summary: Sheathed, charge through enemies and leave wounds that burst and slow. Drawn, dash and slow on contact.
skill.myriad.shuo_yishan.hover.limit: Control during the dash can prevent the wound from bursting.
skill.myriad.shuo_duanliu.hover.summary: Sheathed, cut the same lane twice. Drawn, slash twice up close. Both forms root on two hits.
skill.myriad.shuo_duanliu.hover.limit: Sheathed cuts stay on the first line. Drawn cuts can be aimed separately.
skill.myriad.shuo_wusheng.hover.summary: Sheathed, dash through enemies and cut them on resheathing. Drawn, dash then stun enemies ahead.
skill.myriad.shuo_wusheng.hover.limit: The sheathed cut scales with missing health. A stun or root before it lands cancels it.
skill.myriad.shuo_canyue.hover.summary: Sheathed, recast for three cuts. Land all three to root. Drawn, deliver one wide finishing cut.
skill.myriad.shuo_canyue.hover.limit: Tap for a standing cut. Hold for 0.15 seconds to advance, stopping short of an enemy.
skill.myriad.keheng_kehen.hover.summary: Hit one hero with separate casts to build marks and trigger magic damage.
skill.myriad.keheng_kehen.hover.limit: The first hit starts the timer. Each cast adds at most one mark.
skill.myriad.keheng_hengbu.hover.summary: Gain a shield when you enter your own time field.
skill.myriad.keheng_hengbu.hover.limit: Staying inside does not trigger it again.
skill.myriad.keheng_chizhen.hover.summar: Fire a needle that slows the first enemy it hits.
skill.myriad.keheng_chizhen.hover.limit: Slows the target’s actions. Projectiles already in flight keep their speed.
skill.myriad.keheng_cuopaibu.hover.summa: Dash in your movement direction, gain a shield and leave a time field behind.
skill.myriad.keheng_cuopaibu.hover.limit: From a standstill, dash forward. The field slows enemies and hostile projectiles.
skill.myriad.keheng_chijie.hover.summary: Place a time field that damages enemies as it opens, then slows them and their projectiles.
skill.myriad.keheng_chijie.hover.limit: The placement warns enemies before opening. Walls block its effects.
skill.myriad.keheng_suixing.hover.summar: Carry a time field that damages enemies still inside when it expires.
skill.myriad.keheng_suixing.hover.limit: Recasting or hard control cancels the final hit.
skill.myriad.keheng_yimiao.hover.summary: Place a time dome that slows enemies and their projectiles and pulses magic damage.
skill.myriad.keheng_yimiao.hover.limit: The dome warns before opening. Leave its area to avoid later pulses.
skill.myriad.keheng_zhongke.hover.summar: Charge in place, slowing enemies and projectiles in a lane, then strike along it.
skill.myriad.keheng_zhongke.hover.limit: Your aim locks at cast start. Walls stop the strike.
skill.myriad.luoxia_chase_dusk.hover.sum: Hit an enemy hero with a basic arrow to draw your next shot faster.
skill.myriad.luoxia_chase_dusk.hover.lim: Further basic hits on heroes renew the window.
skill.myriad.luoxia_steady_dusk.hover.su: Hold your draw for a stronger, longer-ranged basic arrow.
skill.myriad.luoxia_steady_dusk.hover.li: Attack speed shortens the draw. Holding at full draw slows movement.

skill.myriad.luoxia_dusk_mark.hover.limi: The follow-up arrow must hit the marked target.
